title: How custom curved wood railings are bent and shipped using Bendywood® - 3 easy steps
description:
Need a curved wood railing for a spiral staircase?

Using Bendywood®, bending handrails can be:
1. bent around a cheap flat mould
2. shipped on a transport mould 
3. bent upwards onto a spiral staircase

In this way, long bending handrails can be easily shipped in a more manageable parcel (2x2 m / 6,5x6,5 feet), allowing you to save time (no more bending mould required) and transport costs!

Find out more about this incredible product at http://www.bendywood.com/en/
